context: This scene takes place in the Shar Grotto, where Shadowheart confronts Viconia in front of an audience of Sharran followers who react with disgust and murmur as the meeting begins. Shadowheart has been marked as disgraced by Lady Shar (or at least accused of failing her), and Viconia — a senior cult figure and possible rival or former superior — taunts her for it. There are two main narrative tracks: Shadowheart may be acting as a loyal Sharran trying to seize leadership of the cult, or she may have broken from Shar and come to free her long-imprisoned parents (a rescue that can trigger a vision of Shar demanding a sacrifice). The player can choose to aid Shadowheart in confronting or defeating Viconia, or betray her instead.
